LanguageData.WallTurret.description:
A turret built into a wall, it doesn't have as much health as a normal turret, however, it won't explode, and fires faster due to the addition of motors on the side of the turret that launches the bullets at a faster rate.
They are more suited for indoor protection compared to outdoors.
